title.zh: RSIGym开源：让AI研究如何改进AI，瞄准递归自我改进
title.en: RSIGym开源：让AI研究如何改进AI，瞄准递归自我改进

current_state.zh: Evolvent AI open-sourced RSIGym, a framework and RSI-Index benchmark that lets research agents autonomously generate training data, tune fine-tuning parameters, and rewrite agent harnesses to improve other AI systems, reporting large gains for Opus 5 while its self-improvement experiment showed no reliable recursive loop.
